meta_description: Phoenix Electrical Southampton provides domestic and commercial electrical work, repairs, and installations. Fast, reliable, and fully insured. Call 07584 306361.
hero_subhead: From rewires to emergency repairs, we keep Southampton homes and businesses safely powered. Fast response, honest pricing.
services_subhead: Whether it's a blown fuse at midnight or a full house rewire, we handle domestic and commercial jobs with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Power cut, tripped electrics, or loose socket? We respond within the hour, any time of day, to get you back online safely.

services.title: Full House & Commercial Rewires
services.desc: Old, dangerous wiring? We carry out complete rewires with building regulations certification, upgrading your safety and future-proofing your home.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Installation
services.desc: Gas boiler installation, underfloor heating, and electric heating systems fitted to specification with full commissioning and guarantees.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Fusebox Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuseboxes with modern consumer units. Improves safety, allows more circuits, and is required for many renovation projects.

services.title: Testing, Certification & Inspections
services.desc: Periodic electrical inspections (EICR), landlord safety certificates, and portable appliance testing for complete peace of mind.

services.title: EV Charging Point Installation
services.desc: Home and workplace electric car charger installation, from quotation through to certification and handover.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I wanted to prove electricians could be honest and fair.
about_para_1: Phoenix Electrical has been serving Southampton and the wider South Coast for over two decades. Founded on the simple principle that electrical work should be transparent, affordable, and done right the first time, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, explaining the job clearly, and delivering a result our customers trust.
about_para_2: Whether you're a homeowner with a leaking boiler or a business needing a full rewire, you'll get the same no-nonsense approach. We hold full liability insurance, work to current Building Regulations, and stand behind every job. Repeat customers come back to us because they know they'll get a straightforward quote, no surprise bills, and an electrician who actually listens.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with our fusebox – kept tripping every time we used the kettle and the oven together. Called Phoenix and they came out the same afternoon. Replaced the whole thing, very professional, explained everything as they went. Brilliant service, fair price, definitely using them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm – our boiler had blown and the house was freezing. Phoenix answered straight away, came out within an hour, and sorted it by midnight. Would have cost a fortune calling someone else. Can't fault them, top job.
reviews.author: Claire R.

reviews.text: We needed the whole upstairs rewired before we could rent it out. Phoenix did the lot, got Building Regs approval, and handled all the paperwork. The lads were tidy, polite, and finished on time. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David W.
